title: Macro Event Guard Configuration
description: Configuration for the macro event guard bot

currencies.description: Currencies whose release calendars to watch (USD works without an API key)

min_tier.description: Highest market tier to include (1 = top-tier releases only, 3 = everything)

lookahead_hours.description: How far ahead to list upcoming releases

guard_minutes.description: Minutes either side of a release that count as a risk window

api_key.description: FXMacroData API key, needed for currencies other than USD
